senses.gloss: वप्र- + अभिघात वप्र- + अभिघात, m. butting at a bank or mound.
वप्र वप्र f. butting at a bank or hillock as or an elephant or bull.

वप्र वप् + र,
 I. m. (and n.).
 1. A field, Kir. 5, 36.
 2. Dust, earth.
 3. A mound, Megh. 2; a hillock.
 4. The foundation of any building.
 5. A shore or bank, Kir. 6, 8.
 6. A rampart, MBh. 1, 5810.
 7. The gate of a fortified city.
 II. m. A father.
 III. f. री, An ant-hill.
 IV. n. Lead.

वप् वप्, i. 1, Par. Ātm.
 I. (properly Caus. of वी).
 1. To sow, MBh. 3, 1248; figurat., Man. 2, 113.
 2. To cast, MBh. 2, 2033.
 3. † To procreate. Pass. उप्य, Man. 9, 26.
 II. (properly a Caus. of वे), To weave.
 III. † To shave.
 --Caus. वापय, To sow, MBh. 3, 18031.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि, To put on, Chr. 294, 4 = Rigv. i. 92, 4.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To sow, MBh. 3, 17341.
 2. To throw to, MBh. 3, 103.
 --Caus. To arrange, to dress, MBh. 1, 819 (cf. with वि).
 --With समा सम्-आ, Caus. To cause to be sown, or thrown in, Lass. 2. ed. 12, 9.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To sow, MBh. 3, 17341.
 2. To offer, Man. 3, 216.
 --With निस् निस्,
 1. To drop. Man. 3, 92.
 2. To sprinkle, Man. 3, 214. []
 3. To offer, Man. 9, 140.
 4. To perform (a sacrifice), Man. 4, 10; 6, 38 (read निरुप्य).
 --Caus. To disseminate, Pañc. 85, 20.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To sow, MBh. 3, 15725.
 2. To cast, ib. 3, 1931.
 --With प्रति प्रति, To inlay, to stud, to adorn, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 16. प्रत्युप्त, Shut(?), Utt. Rāmac. 87, 3.
 --With वि वि, व्युप्त, Disordered, dishevelled, Bhāg. P. 4, 2, 14.
 --Cf. ὀπυίω and ὄιϕω, ὄιϕεω; A.S. wíf; probably also ὅπλον; Goth. vêpn; A.S. waepen. Cf. वे.

वप वप, i. e.
 I. वप् + अ, m.
 1. Sowing seed.
 2. Shaving.
 II. f. पा.
 1. The mucous or glutinous secretion of the flesh or bones, marrow, Rām. 1, 13, 39.
 2. Fat, Man. 12, 63.
 3. Any hole or cavity.
वाप वाप, i. e. वप् + अ, m. Shaving, shearing, Man. 11, 108.

वपन वप् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Sowing seed.
 2. Semen virile.
 3. Shaving, Man. 5, 140.
 II. f. नी, A barber's shop.
वापन वापन, i. e. वप् + अन, n. Shaving, shearing, Man. 11, 78.
ऽवपुष -वपुष, i. e. वपुस् + अ, at the end of comp. instead of वपुस्, in वराह-, n. The body of a hog, Johns. Sel. 94, 53.

वपुष्मन्त् वपुष्मन्त्, i. e. वपुस् + मन्त्, adj., f. मती,
 1. Having a body, corporeal, embodied, Kir. 2, 59, Lass. 2. ed. 76, 47.
 2. Beautiful, Sund. 3, 17.

वपुस् वपुस् (cf. वपा), n.
 1. The body, Pañc. iii. d. 221.
 2. A handsome form or figure, Śāk. d. 16.
 3. Beauty, Chr. 290, 4 = Rigv. i. 64, 4 (dat. in the sense of the infin. ‘In order to be beautiful’).

वप्तृ वप् + तृ,
 I. m., f. तॄ, and n.
 1. Who or what sows.
 2. A husbandman, Man. 3, 142.
 II. m.
 1. A progenitor, a father.
 2. A poet.
वप्यटदेवी वप्यट-देवी, f. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 281.
वप्रि वप् + रि, m.(?), A field.

वापि and वापी वापी̆, f. A pond, Ṛt. 6, 3 (पी); Pañc. iii. d. 91 (पी); an oblong reservoir of water.
 --Comp.
